name: Liquidity Sweep Reversal
thesis: Resting stops beyond obvious swings are liquidity; their harvest by larger players marks exhaustion, and fast reclaim of the level signals the real direction (Wyckoff spring).
invalidation: Demote after 6 consecutive losses or profit factor below 0.85 over 20 trades.

provenance.note: APPROXIMATE port: eval_sweep_reversal scans the last max_reclaim_bars+1 bars for a pierce of a swing taken from df[-60:-k-1]. This tests only the current bar's low against a 56-bar Donchian, so a pierce that was reclaimed two bars ago is missed — it fires roughly 5x less often (28 vs 143 signals on 8000 bars). Widening this is a candidate for tuning.
